note: Reference lipids recovered from AGILE Supplementary Information (Xu et al., Nat Commun 15:6305, 2024, MOESM1). Structures derived from the stated IUPAC names and named Ugi components, then verified against the reported ESI-MS formula and M+H. Not present in our training corpus under these names.

H9.reported_performance: 7.8-fold greater intramuscular expression than MC3; comparable to ALC-0315; substantially lower liver and spleen expression than both; lower ALT/AST than ALC-0315
H9.selection_provenance: top-ranked of 15 AGILE HeLa candidates drawn from a ~12,000-member candidate library filtered from a ~60,000-member virtual library

agile_candidate_library_scope.note: This is the space H9 was selected from, and is the correct comparison for our generated component space.

agile_self_description: AGILE state in their Discussion: 'the current deep learning model in AGILE is not generative in nature as it does not create ionizable lipid structures', and name integration of generative models as future work.
